# D recovery published-ID target comparison

Temporary conversion evidence; deleted at milestone F (cutover).

Reference: 0.66.0 `base.db`, schema 4, read in place with SQLite read-only flags.
Generation: `d6b45021d1191871ce18bd88a850fe20860bae8c4daafddfeea94ed7837206d0`.

All 57,462 published variable PIDs and 498,480 bound occurrence memberships were
compared against the existing Rust resolver after applying current locked curation.
Coordinates are table PID, exact spelling and source key, with effective period ranges
normalized only by duplicate/adjacent union. The actual emitter supplies PID and date
encoding. The temporary harness calls the existing readers, curation runner and
resolver; it never emits or copies a catalog.

**Result: zero missing or retargeted published IDs.** Exactly 57,165 PIDs have identical
normalized memberships. The following 297 PIDs have justified additions: 212 extend
existing-coordinate period ranges, 84 add exact case-alias coordinates and one does
both. Every old coordinate/period witness remains. Every added interval is covered by
464 distinct branch-added assertions with matching explicit key guards, and every added
coordinate retains an existing table, folded spelling and native source key. There are
no unsupported additions, new source keys or new tables under any published PID.

The initial comparison exposed the four restored FoU setters moving 2019/2021 STRAT
coverage between `stratum-strat` and `stratum`. Those setters were withdrawn and the
full comparison rerun. Both FoU PIDs now match 0.66.0 exactly. The 35 r257 published
anchors preserve their original families: 33 match exactly; `lilla-n-per-stratum` and
`weight` have the documented older case-alias occurrences listed below, under the same
native keys. HO, the 30 `cis2002-*` natives and the two dated anchors match exactly. The
current resolver also reports zero unminted, merged, split or unplaced IDs and 42 new
variable PIDs.

Every changed PID is listed below. Periods are inclusive. Unchanged coordinate groups
are omitted: an empty Before column means that only new exact-spelling coordinates were
added. Statement citations are the exact authored assertions whose scopes cover all
added intervals; their evidence names the original legacy source entry. No variable
identity is inferred from labels.
